W: Simply put, we shred discarded fabric, turn it into a watery mixture called slurry, and then dry it and press it into new sheets of fabric. That fabric is then available to create new products. Reducing unnecessary waste is our goal.
M: It sounds like a great way to use leftover materials.
W: Unfortunately, our facility is currently able to process only cotton waste. But in the next few years, we should be able to recycle more types of textiles here. It's my hope that it could eventually become as common as recycling aluminum is now.

Attention, customers of George's Grocery.
We are pleased to share the launch of our shopper's rewards program and want you to be a part of it!
This new program offers all members exclusive perks like personalized coupons and special discounts.
Signing up is easy and can be done right at the register when you check out.
Just present your driver's license or other identification and you'll be given a membership card.
Also, don't forget that we will be closed tomorrow in honor of the national holiday.

At Job Lift Enterprises, we provide hands-on training to help you learn the skills and earn the certifications that tech professionals need.
Unlike other job-training programs, our courses are tuition-free.

Our schools are conveniently located throughout the Grand Lakes region.

lessons.transcriptFull:
I'd like to thank you all for attending Omnicom Department Store's staff meeting.
As you'll recall, six months ago we made a deal with Euphoria sports clothing to sell their merchandise exclusively in our department stores.
The hope is that we can attract new customers to our stores by selling this brand.
Data show that foot traffic in the department stores containing Euphoria clothing is up twenty percent from last year.
Keep in mind, however, that total sales revenues are still being calculated.

Thanks for inviting me to represent the parking authority at this month's city council meeting.
As you know, parking in city parking garages will no longer be free on Saturdays.
My office has updated the parking rate schedule and posted copies in all city garages.
If you look at the screen, you'll see the new rates that went into effect this week.
We're planning to use some of the additional revenue to cover the cost of new payment kiosks for the garages.
I will provide a revenue report at next month's meeting.
